definitions.explanation: One end or extremity of a physical object such as a rope, road, or line.

definitions.gloss: a part, a glimpse, one aspect
definitions.explanation: A portion or fragment of something larger, often used to describe catching a glimpse of someone's character, ability, or a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: I tied one end of the rope to a tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{向|む}こう{岸|ぎし}→向こう岸：27267_mukougishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I could see the other bank from one end of the bridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Connect one end of the cable to A and the other end to B.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I got a glimpse of her talent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{苦悩|くのう}→苦悩：05517_kunou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}している→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: This work expresses a part of his anguish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}っていた→担う：12787_ninau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: It became clear that he had played a part in the incident.

notes:
USAGE: The two senses have different usage patterns.

Sense 1 (one end): Used for physical objects with two ends.
- ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん} (one end of a rope)
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん} (one end of a road)

Sense 2 (a part/glimpse): Used with abstract nouns to mean "a part of" or "a glimpse of."
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一端|いったん} (a glimpse of talent)
- {一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧ (to play a part in)
- {一端|いったん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{垣間見|かいまみ}る→垣間見る：09909_kaimamiru⟧ (to catch a glimpse of)

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{一旦|いったん}→一旦：04099_ittan⟧ (once, temporarily), which is an adverb with a completely different meaning.
